features: Maintains Absorption After 500+ Washes - Ultra-absorbent and leak-proof washable dog pee pads. Our multi-layered reusable puppy pads feature a waterproof TPU coating that effectively absorbs and retains liquid, preventing leaks and odors. Designed to withstand repeated washing & urine soaking, these durable whelping pads are perfect for housebreaking, incontinence, or post-surgery care. The non-slip backing keeps the pad securely in place, making it ideal for use on hardwood floors or in crates.

Versatile Washable Pee Pads for Dogs and Puppies - Not only do our reusable dog pee pads provide reliable floor protection, but they also add a touch of style to your home. Available in various trendy colors and patterns, these pads seamlessly blend with your interior decor while offering a comfortable and safe surface for your furry friend to play, rest, or sleep on. The machine-washable design makes them a cost-effective and environmentally friendly choice for long-term use.

Multipurpose Reusable Pee Pads for Cats and Dogs - Our highly absorbent and leak-proof pet pads are also suitable for use with cats, making them a versatile solution for multi-pet households. The generous size and superior liquid retention capacity make these pads ideal for litter box training, senior cats with incontinence, or protecting furniture from accidents. Machine washable and reusable, these cat pee pads offer a budget-friendly and sustainable alternative to disposable options.

Versatile Pet Mat for Crates, Playpens, and Floors - These multi-functional washable dog pee pads double as a comfortable mat for crates, playpens, or floor use. The soft, quilted surface provides a cozy resting spot for your pet, while the waterproof and leak-proof design protects your floors and furniture from accidents, spills, and pet hair. Perfect for travel, outdoor use, or as a designated pet area in your home, these versatile mats are a must-have for every pet owner.
